environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate task in a VPC private subnet (10.0.128.0/20). The subnet route table has only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for internet-facing services, and no transit gateway attachment. The only VPC endpoint configured is com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.dkr (for image pull) and com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs (for CloudWatch). Security group sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f allows inbound from internal ALB only (sg-9f8e7d6c5b4a on port 8080) and has NO egress rules beyond the implicit deny-all (egress rules: allow TCP 443 to pl-63a5400a [S3 prefix list] only). Network ACL on the subnet explicitly denies all outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 except TCP 443 to the VPC CIDR range. The ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/NoInternetBoundary) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface and ec2:AttachNetworkInterface actions.

config.security_group_egress: TCP 443 to pl-63a5400a (S3 prefix list) only
